summary: Teaching string synth: one Dye Essence patch driven by 12 controls. A Karplus-Strong string: a delay line plucked with a burst of noise (its hardness and where on the string), a loop that loses treble (damping) and a little level each time round (a decay time of 0.05 to 20 s at any note), a dispersion all-pass that stiffens it toward a piano wire or a chime, and sympathetic strings an octave and a fifth up, with an ADSR, unison and an output gain. Every control says what it does and what you will hear. Use it for harps, guitars, harpsichords, kotos, pianos and bells, or to learn how plucked-string synthesis works.
use_for: A teaching plucked-string synth (Karplus-Strong): harps, guitars, harpsichords and bells from a pick position, damping, a decay time that holds at any note, stiffness and sympathetic strings.

parameters.name: Pick Position
parameters.description: Pre-filters the initial excitation impulse with a comb notch corresponding to where the string is plucked (0% Bridge -> 100% Center).
parameters.how: Pre-filters the initial excitation impulse with a comb notch corresponding to where the string is plucked (0% Bridge -> 100% Center).
parameters.sound: Plucking near the bridge sounds sharp, nasal, and harpsichord-like; plucking near the center sounds round and hollow.

parameters.name: String Damping
parameters.description: Adjusts the cutoff of the one-pole low-pass filter inside the delay feedback loop.
parameters.how: Adjusts the cutoff of the one-pole low-pass filter inside the delay feedback loop.
parameters.sound: Low damping lets bright metallic harmonics ring out; high damping absorbs treble rapidly like a nylon or palm-muted guitar.

parameters.name: Pick Hardness
parameters.description: Controls the duration and high-frequency content of the noise/impulse burst injected into the delay line at note-on.
parameters.how: Controls the duration and high-frequency content of the noise/impulse burst injected into the delay line at note-on.
parameters.sound: Morphs the initial attack from a soft flesh thumb brush to a stiff nylon plectrum or hard metal hammer.

parameters.name: Decay Time
parameters.description: Sets the loop gain per cycle from the pitch, so the string falls 60 dB in this time at any note (T60).
parameters.how: Sets the loop gain per cycle from the pitch, so the string falls 60 dB in this time at any note (T60).
parameters.sound: Controls how long the string sustains after being plucked, from tight staccato ticks to long harp rings.

parameters.name: Stiffness
parameters.description: Increases the all-pass filter coefficient inside the feedback loop so high frequencies travel faster than low frequencies.
parameters.how: Increases the all-pass filter coefficient inside the feedback loop so high frequencies travel faster than low frequencies.
parameters.sound: Pushes the string physics from an ideal flexible guitar string into a stiff piano wire, chime, or metallic bell.

parameters.name: Sympathetic
parameters.description: Bleeds a fraction of the plucked string's energy into a bank of unplucked octaves and fifths delay lines.
parameters.how: Bleeds a fraction of the plucked string's energy into a bank of unplucked octaves and fifths delay lines.
parameters.sound: Adds the lush, resonant halo of unplayed strings vibrating sympathetically across a harp, sitar, or acoustic guitar body.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.sound: Low values create immediate, percussive plucks; high values produce slow, swelling pads.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.how: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.sound: Short decay makes notes snappy and tight; longer decay gives a gradual piano- or bell-like fade.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.how: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.sound: At 0% the synth behaves like a plucked or struck instrument; at 100% it holds full organ-like volume.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.sound: Short release stops notes abruptly; long release leaves an ambient tail that blends chords together.

parameters.name: Unison / Spread
parameters.description: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.sound: Thickens thin waveforms into wide, chorus-like stereo leads and pads.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.how: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.sound: Controls overall loudness; keep the clip light dark when the next machine expects levels at or below 0 dBFS.
